purpose: canonical confirmation that perp-v1 landed RETIRED with four non-PASS verdicts
sql: select e.key, e.state, (select count(*) from experiment_arms a join experiment_versions v2 on v2.id=a.version_id where v2.experiment_id=e.id) as arms, (select count(*) from experiment_gates g join experiment_versions v3 on v3.id=g.version_id where v3.experiment_id=e.id) as gates, (select count(*) from experiment_gate_results r where r.experiment_id=e.id) as results, (select count(*) from experiment_gate_results r where r.experiment_id=e.id and r.verdict='PASS') as passes, (select string_agg(distinct r.computed_by, ',') from experiment_gate_results r where r.experiment_id=e.id) as computed_by, (select count(*) from experiment_deployments d join experiment_epochs ep on ep.id=d.epoch_id join experiment_versions v4 on v4.id=ep.version_id where v4.experiment_id=e.id) as deployments from experiments e where e.key='perp-v1'
